name: Cheesy Beef Smash Burger Tacos with Lettuce, Tomato, Salsa & Sour Cream

ingredients.name: fresh cut taco fixings (onion, tomato, lettuce, tomato, cheese)

instructions.primary_message: Place beef and taco seasoning in a medium bowl. Season with salt and pepper if desired. Mix until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb lean ground beef
1 (1 oz) pkg taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the beef mixture into 8 rounded meatballs. Transfer to a plate.
Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then top each with a prepared meatball. Using your hands, spread the beef over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add 1 teaspoon oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches (and adding more oil as needed), add tacos, meat-side down, to the skillet. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the beef is cooked through, 3-4 minutes.

Flip tacos, beef-side up, and sprinkle with a small handful of cheese. Continue to cook until cheese has melted, 1 minute more. Transfer to a clean plate or platter. (Reserve remaining fixings for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (24 oz) pkg fresh cut taco fixings (onion, tomato, lettuce, tomato, cheese)

instructions.primary_message: Fill tacos with remaining fixings (onion, tomato, lettuce, and more cheese if desired) and top with a dollop of sour cream. Serve with salsa on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup sour cream
1 cup salsa
